result.title: Silence and Noise: Resolving Suppression and Overvaluation in Multimodal Entity Alignment
result.summary: Multimodal entity alignment (MMEA) is fundamental to integrating heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs), yet existing paradigms remain critically vulnerable to incomplete modalities and cross-graph structural asymmetries. This paper exposes a fundamental oversight in current MMEA research: treating feature missingness and topological discrepancies as isolated preprocessing or denoising challenges, which overlooks their destructive coupling during multimodal fusion. We systematically formulate and evaluate two newly identified failure modes: 1) Detail Missing (DM)-induced overvaluation, where the absence of local modality details causes models to overemphasize uninformative, blurred representations; and 2) Context Imbalance (CI)-induced suppression, where topological discrepancies across KGs allow dense structural contexts to overwhelm weaker but highly discriminative modal signals, triggering high-level semantic drift. To break this cycle of degradation, we introduce ALMEA, a generative and calibration framework that establishes a bidirectional feedback loop between low-level feature reconstruction and high-level latent space alignment. Specifically, Cross-Modality Imputation (CMI) synthesizes missing modality details to mitigate overvaluation, while Latent Semantic Calibration (LSC) aligns cross-graph joint embeddings to suppress topology-driven semantic drift. Under sparse supervision, we develop Controlled Iterative Selection (CIS) to adaptively acquire representative and diverse pseudo-labeled pairs, optimizing latent calibration under constrained budgets. Extensive evaluations on standard benchmarks demonstrate that ALMEA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. At a 20% supervision rate, ALMEA yields substantial absolute improvements of up to 5.20% in MRR and 6.40% in Hits@1, maintaining robust gains across higher supervision thresholds.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究多模态实体对齐中模态缺失与跨图谱拓扑不对称的耦合失效，提出 ALMEA 框架：以跨模态补全合成缺失模态细节，用 latent 语义校准对齐跨图联合嵌入，并在稀疏监督下用受控迭代选择获取伪标签对。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「细节缺失导致模糊表征被高估」与「稠密结构上下文压制弱模态信号」的表述，可能对应 LVR 中视觉旁路、latent 信息坍缩与模态贡献分配问题，latent 校准与伪标签筛选机制可供核查借鉴。
